affected.note: Maximum figure from the second report (2026-10-21), limited to @nifty Hikari line applications made since 2019 other than through the website. The first report (2026-10-19) gave a maximum of 542,513 applications across three services; @nifty MAX Hikari and @nifty au Hikari Plus were later found to be out of scope. Email addresses, passwords, bank and card data were not involved.

summary.en: NIFTY announced on 2026-10-19 that its internal management system for registering broadband line applications had been accessed without authorization. After narrowing the scope, it said up to 18,000 @nifty Hikari application records, including member IDs, names, birthdates, addresses and phone numbers, may have leaked.
summary.ja: ニフティは2026年10月19日、回線申込の顧客情報を登録する社内の申込・受付管理システムが不正アクセスを受けたと発表した。その後の調査で対象を絞り込み、「＠nifty光」の申込情報最大18,000件の会員ID、氏名、生年月日、住所、電話番号などが漏えいした可能性があるとした。
